provenance.author: David Schirduan (Technical Grimoire)
provenance.basedOn: Kintsugi, technicalgrimoire.com/kintsugi. Inspired by Game of Clones (Marshall Miller) and Roll for Shoes.
provenance.entries: Story seed lists verbatim from the Kintsugi pamphlet, minus each entry's final full stop. Name and description tables are shared with the Roll for Shoes tools.

setting.premise: You pretend to be someone who can't die and quickly learns new skills: a robot, magical golem, or mutant.

kin.goal.v: Learn 7 wildly differing skills. E.g. History, Archery, Lockpicking, VCR Repair, etc
Escape your pursuers. They know your appearance, your skills, and your general location
Find your creator and convince them to release you from bondage. You may need to be...persuasive
Start a new life. Gather supplies for a long journey, cut all ties, and establish yourself in a distant land
Make breakfast. One vegan omelette, two strips of bacon, hash browns, sausage gravy biscuits, and a glass of orange juice
Become a hero of the people, known across the land, beloved by all

kin.cannot.v: Harm anyone or any living thing. Not even a fly
Be seen in public. Word of you will spread
Remember anything. You have no memories of your past, your purpose, or your creation
Learn more than 3 skills (excluding "Do Anything"). Any new skills you learn replace your old skills
Enter certain environments (sunlight, rivers, freshly planted gardens, morning mists, smoggy cities, etc)
Reach your potential. Cross out your skills when they reach 5 instead of 6

kin.unfortunately.v: Low on energy, food, or supplies
Far away from where you want to be
Fragile and weak. (After you cross out 3 skills then 3+ skills max out, you perish)
